# Rust operation modules use the operation name, while bridge names follow each language

The folder creation implementation lives in client/create_folder.rs, with create_folder methods in Rust and CreateFolder in the XPCOM bridge macro. Its parameters use parent_id in Rust and parentId in the IDL. Proposed naming pattern in these owned protocol modules: pair the snake_case operation filename/method with the generated method’s declared case and keep the domain argument meaning unchanged. This is a local bridge convention, not a rule to rename wire fields. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.

Scope: EWS operation naming.
